purpose: Prospective scheduling of required integrated verification after the single rejected-increment admission candidate is frozen
required_reconciliation: Collect the exact historical33-module selection plus the separately frozen director module; reconcile every collected ID against disjoint actually executed current-product selections, with unchanged effective JIT/thread/retired-programme settings and source/dependency hashes.
new_director_checks: Owner's full-target pilot and remaining disjoint tests must all bind the same final product, common oracle dependency and new test module. Earlier two preyield passes on the old product are historical, not automatically counted as current-product verification.
do_not_start: No root numerical invocation while the owner holds the numerical slot; no integrated verification before exact source/test freeze; no diagnostic use of the protected reserve.
failure_policy: Retain all failures and precise process-wall receipts. Rerun only affected checks after a justified repair fitting the remaining allowance. Missing or failed verification keeps the corresponding acceptance gate open.
scientific_policy: No analytical, mesh, material-state, completion or compatibility criterion is waived by regression success. Existing force-controlled mesh/reference evidence requires explicit source-impact assessment if reused.
release: Development acceptance only; no Git delivery or qualification status change.
